propositions: jira_dc_pat fixture is function-scoped, causing one Personal Access Token to be minted per test, exhausting Jira DC's 10-PAT-per-user cap when many tests run
PAT creation failure occurs at setup of arbitrary unrelated tests because the cap is session-wide, not specific to the test where the exception surfacea
PAT minting with expirationDuration=1 causes failures to appear deterministic within a run window but intermittent across days as tokens self-clear
Changing jira_dc_pat to session scope makes token consumption O(1) instead of O(tests), allowing the full test suite to run within the 10-token budget
A sweep of leftover rebar-j5-harness-* tokens at session start prevents poisoning from crashed runs that leave tokens behind
The sweep must degrade gracefully when the PAT endpoint is unavailable or returns malformed data, never raising exceptions that abort the session
